title: Mobile App Developer – Fresher
description:
**Company:** Aipxperts Technolabs Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Bodakdev, Ahmedabad  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office Only  
**Experience:** Fresher with 6 Months Internship/Training Experience  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Agreement:** 1\-Year Employment Agreement

Job Overview

Aipxperts is looking for a passionate and motivated **Mobile App Developer – Fresher** to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have completed an internship or practical training in **Mobile App Development** and should be eager to build a career in mobile application development.

Required Skills

* 6 months of internship/training experience in **Mobile App Development**
* Internship must be specifically related to **Mobile Application Development**
* Basic understanding of mobile app development concepts
* Good knowledge of any mobile development technology such as:
* Android Native
* iOS Native
* Flutter
* React Native
* Understanding of UI development and API integration will be an advantage
* Good problem\-solving and logical\-thinking skills
* **Good communication skills**
* Willingness to learn and work in a professional development environment

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain mobile applications under the guidance of senior developers
* Write clean and maintainable code
* Work on new features and application enhancements
* Debug and fix application issues
* Integrate APIs and third\-party services as required
* Collaborate with the development and QA teams
* Learn and follow company coding standards and development practices
* Participate in testing, debugging, and deployment activities

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers who have completed a **6\-month Mobile App Development internship/training**
* Candidates with practical project experience in mobile application development
* Candidates who are passionate about learning and building a career in mobile development
* Candidates who are comfortable working **from office**

Job Details

**Location:** Bodakdev, Ahmedabad  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office Only  
**Experience:** Fresher / 6 Months Internship Experience  
**Agreement:** 1 Year  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated CV at:

**prachi.parmar@aipxperts.com**

**Join Aipxperts and start your career in Mobile App Development!**

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹22,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Flutter Developer Intern
description:
Flutter Developer Intern

**Company:** Infyx Infotech  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Job Type:** Internship  
**Position:** Flutter Developer Intern  
**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year  
**Duration:** 6 Months  
**Work Mode:** On\-site

About Infyx Infotech

Infyx Infotech is a software development company delivering modern digital solutions including custom software, ERP systems, web and mobile applications, CRM, e\-commerce solutions, automation, and cloud\-based platforms.

We are looking for an enthusiastic **Flutter Developer Intern** who is passionate about mobile application development and eager to gain hands\-on experience working on real\-world projects.

Roles \& Responsibilities

* Develop mobile applications using **Flutter \& Dart**
* Build clean, responsive, and user\-friendly mobile interfaces
* Integrate **REST APIs** and backend services
* Work with JSON data and API responses
* Implement application navigation, forms, validations, and reusable components
* Handle state management using Provider, Riverpod, GetX, BLoC, or similar approaches
* Identify and fix bugs and performance issues
* Work with Git/GitHub for version control
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and senior developers
* Participate in testing, debugging, and application deployment
* Follow clean coding and development best practices

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**
* Understanding of mobile app development concepts
* Basic knowledge of **REST API integration**
* Familiarity with Android/iOS application development
* Understanding of responsive UI development
* Basic knowledge of Git/GitHub
* Good problem\-solving and logical thinking skills
* Willingness to learn new technologies

Good to Have

Knowledge or exposure to **Firebase, push notifications, Google Maps, payment gateway integration, local storage, authentication, and app publishing** will be an advantage.

Who Can Apply?

Students, recent graduates, and freshers from **BE/B.Tech, BCA, MCA, BSc IT, MSc IT, Computer Science, IT**, or related backgrounds can apply.

Candidates who have already developed academic, personal, or live Flutter projects will be preferred.

What You’ll Gain

You’ll get hands\-on experience working on **real\-world mobile applications**, API integrations, modern development practices, Git workflows, and complete application development cycles under the guidance of an experienced development team.

Pay: From ₹15,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
